t: Fix hub spoke YELLOW health: 12 lug schema violations + 11 mislocated lugs
description: Hub spoke health check returns YELLOW with 3 failures: lug-schema (12/12 active lugs have violations), lug-pev (12 actionable lugs missing PEV fields), lug-location (11 lugs in wrong bytype/ location). All 12 lugs are the Librarian epic children at WAI-Spoke/lugs/bytype/implementation/in_progress/ but their status field says 'open' not 'in_progress' — they're in the wrong folder. They also use full key names ('id', 'title') but are missing required fields (fw_ver, rt, impact, effort, perceive/execute/verify).
perceive: Run spoke_health_check.py --json on hub spoke. Read each of the 12 active lugs. Document exact violations per lug (missing fields, wrong folder, key format).
execute: For each lug: (1) Add missing fields: fw_ver='3.0.0', rt='LOCAL', impact/effort scores, perceive/execute/verify fields. (2) Move status='open' lugs from in_progress/ to open/ folder OR update status to 'p' if work has genuinely started. (3) Fix the 2 skill registry warnings (4 skills without local dirs, 1 orphan dir). (4) Re-run health check to verify GREEN.
verify: Run python3 tools/spoke_health_check.py /home/mario/projects/wheelwright/hub — must return GREEN with 0 failures.
acceptance_criteria: Hub spoke health check returns GREEN (0 failures)
All lugs in correct bytype/ folder matching their status
